Bu, Kai Zhang, and Sanglu Lu. 2022. Thru-the-wall Eavesdropping

Proceedings of the ACM on Interactive, Mobile, Wearable and Ubiquitous

paper_level_summary_zh: 该论文引用 [23]（Rydberg Atoms 教科书）仅作为基础物理原理说明，用于解释里德伯原子及其电子跃迁，未涉及目标论文的 RFID 亚毫米级感知或穿墙窃听能力。属于普通参考文献引用，不应作为能力佐证。

evidences.evidence_quote: In quantum systems, an atom with electrons at high energy levels (i.e., above level 20) is called a Rydberg atom [23].
evidences.evidence_context: The basic principle of a quantum receiver is that the electrons of an atom (e.g., Cesium atom) are triggered to higher energy levels to receive RF signals. For example, to receive 2.4 GHz WiFi signals, the electrons are triggered from energy level 6 to energy level 66. In quantum systems, an atom with electrons at high energy levels (i.e., above level 20) is called a Rydberg atom [23].
evidences.reference_entry: Thomas Gallagher. 2006. Rydberg Atoms. Springer New York, New York, NY, 235–245. https://doi.org/10.1007/978-0-387-26308-3_14
evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: 证据引用 [23] 仅作为里德伯原子的通用定义来源，[23] 是教科书，并非目标论文。目标论文标题为 'Thru-the-wall Eavesdropping on Loudspeakers via RFID by Capturing Sub-mm Level Vibration'，与 Rydberg 原子教科书无关。属于误引。 原文证据句引用了其他编号，没有引用目标论文编号。
evidences.copy_ready_zh: 该证据引用的 [23] 是物理学教科书，并非目标论文，属于误引，不予采纳。

evidences.evidence_quote: Based on the Schrödinger equation [23], E′(t) can be measured in both macroscopic and microscopic perspectives.
evidences.evidence_context: From the macroscopic perspective, conventional receivers receive RF signals using antennas. From the microscopic perspective, quantum receiver received RF signals using the electron energy transition of atoms. Based on the Schrödinger equation [23], E′(t) can be measured in both macroscopic and microscopic perspectives. The difference is the measurement precision.
evidences.reference_entry: Thomas Gallagher. 2006. Rydberg Atoms. Springer New York, New York, NY, 235–245. https://doi.org/10.1007/978-0-387-26308-3_14
